step1_analysis.description: A basic NMOS differential pair with an NMOS tail current source. It acts as a transconductor (Gm cell) and is likely used as a fundamental building block in the analog turbo decoder's sum-product algorithm implementation (e.g., in Gilbert multipliers or log-domain circuits).

paper_reference.title: A 13.3Mb/s 0.35µm CMOS Analog Turbo Decoder IC with a Configurable Interleaver

Voltage Gain (Av).description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain (assuming 50kOhm resistive loads added for testing)

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 2*Id/Vov. Id=10uA, Vov~0.086V -> gm~232uS. Av = gm*RL = 232uS * 50kOhm = 11.6 V/V = 21.3 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends on exact Vth and mobility in SKY130, but with 50k loads, gain should be around 20-22 dB.

Tail Current (Iss).description: Total bias current provided by the tail transistor XM1

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated using square law model; actual value may vary due to short channel effects and exact Vth.

Power Consumption.description: Total static power consumption of the differential pair

sky130_expected.reasoning: Directly proportional to tail current and supply voltage.
This is a system-level metric for the entire turbo decoder, not applicable to a single differential pair.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure tail current, power, AC voltage gain, and transient differential swing of the NMOS differential pair with 50kOhm loads.
step3_testbench.spice:
* NMOS Differential Pair Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N0 VBIAS_B GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 IOUTn VINp N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 IOUTp VINn N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VDD VDD 0 1.8
VVBIAS_B VBIAS_B 0 0.54
VVINp VINp 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.05 1MEG 0 0 0)
VVINn VINn 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 0.05 1MEG 0 0 180)

* Added loads to convert output currents to voltages for measurement
RL1 IOUTn VDD 50k
RL2 IOUTp VDD 50k
CL1 IOUTn 0 100f
CL2 IOUTp 0 100f

* Dependent source to measure differential output voltage
E1 VOUT_DIFF 0 IOUTp IOUTn 1

.control
op
* Tail current is the total current drawn from VDD (through RL1 and RL2)
let iss = -i(VDD)
let power = iss * 1.8
print iss power

ac dec 100 1k 1G
let gain_db = vdb(VOUT_DIFF)
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=1k
meas ac gain_10M find gain_db at=10MEG

tran 1n 5u
meas tran vout_diff_max max v(VOUT_DIFF)
meas tran vout_diff_min min v(VOUT_DIFF)
let diff_swing = vout_diff_max - vout_diff_min
print diff_swing
quit
.endc
